before: names(values) <- c("a","b") labels the two positions. Labels do not alter their stored numeric values.
values["b"] selects the entry named b. A name is not the same thing as its position number.
For this bracket lookup, an absent name produces NA. Do not assume a misspelled name selects the first entry.

```r
values <- c(10, 20)
names(values) <- c("a", "b")
cat(values["b"])
```
